result.instructions: Tools for PipeRun, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals in our sales pipeline have had no activity for more than five days?"; "Show the open deals owned by Carla and their total value."; "Create a follow-up call for the deal with Acme tomorrow at 10:00.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PipeRun data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run piperun_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run piperun_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run piperun_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. piperun_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: piperun_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List deals (oportunidades) with filters for pipeline, stage, person, company, owner, title and last update date. Returns one page and meta.cursor.next. GET /deals.

show.description: Items per page (the API default applies when omitted).

cursor.description: Cursor from meta.cursor.next of the previous page. Leave empty for the first page.

temperature.description: Deal temperature: 1 very hot, 2 hot, 3 warm, 4 cold.

updated_at_start.description: Only deals updated on or after this date.

updated_at_end.description: Only deals updated on or before this date.

with.description: Add one related object to each result. Only one value: the API slows down with chained values.

tools.name: piperun_get_deal
tools.title: Get a deal
tools.description: Get one deal (oportunidade) by id, with its pipeline, stage, owner and value. GET /deals/{deal_id}.

with.description: Add one related object to each result. Only one value: the API slows down with chained values.

tools.name: piperun_create_deal
tools.title: Create a deal
tools.description: Create a deal (oportunidade) in a pipeline stage. Creates a new record in the CRM. POST /deals.

value.description: Deal value (products and services), in the account currency.

temperature.description: Deal temperature: 1 very hot, 2 hot, 3 warm, 4 cold.

tools.name: piperun_update_deal
tools.title: Update a deal
tools.description: Change fields of one deal (oportunidade): move it to another stage, rename it, change its value, owner, person, company or temperature. Only the fields you send change. PUT /deals/{deal_id}.

temperature.description: Deal temperature: 1 very hot, 2 hot, 3 warm, 4 cold.
